items.title: Sid Davilla Interview, 1969-04-17
items.q: Paul Baldwin would work a while. By a while, I mean some months.

ctx.x: Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Well, can you tell me about how it was that you decided to hire George Lewis, the George Lewis band, and the circumstances, anything you can remember to hire him? George Lewis, yes.

There were a number of good bands around town, of which George had one. And our policy was not to keep the same band for much too long. We would change bands and alternate bands. Paul Baldwin would work a while. By a while, I mean some months. George would come in with his band, and this actually is the last spot that Papa Celestan worked a steady engagement. Two weeks after he left here is when I think he was stricken fatally and died. This is his last steady job right here, Papa Celestan. George was here at two…
So, where did you, how was it that you had heard George play? Where did you heard him play before getting in here?
